scenario: A clinical pharmacist is reviewing a chronic-pain patient's opioid regimen ahead of a quarterly medication management visit. The workflow converts the patient's daily opioid doses (multiple agents at different strengths) into Morphine Milligram Equivalents using a unit converter, feeds the resulting total daily MME into a drug safety review to check whether the dose is within evidence-based thresholds, and finally generates a structured health report for the prescribing physician summarizing the MME calculation, risk category, and recommended next steps.
info_flow: unit-convert computes each opioid agent's daily dose in MME and sums them into a total_mme_per_day figure → drug-safety-review ingests total_mme_per_day alongside patient demographics to classify opioid risk level and generate dosing alerts → health-report formats the risk classification and recommendations into a physician-facing quarterly review document.
